name: Every Lead Alert

parameters.content: Every Lead Alert: receives lead + appointment data from any intake workflow, builds an HTML email and SMS summary showing the auto-booked appointment time, then sends an email and SMS to the owner (both default ON, since SMS is how the owner triggers a reschedule). The owner never needs to open Google Sheets.

description: Every Lead Alert sub-workflow - called by Form Capture/Missed-Call workflows for every new lead. Sends a professional email to the owner (default ON) and an optional SMS (default OFF), both centrally configurable via the CONFIG block.
